# LJI Industries

> A digital content studio and the publisher of Briefed, a daily US news briefing with sources you can check, a short daily podcast, and short news videos.

Website: https://ljiindustries.com/
Contact: info@ljiindustries.com

## Briefed
Briefed is a daily US-focused news briefing: the facts on the day's stories, with links to original reporting and official sources, so readers can see what's confirmed and what's still developing.

- Today's edition: https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/ (published each morning around 4:45 AM ET)
- Archive by date: https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/archive/
- About Briefed: https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/about/
- Podcast RSS: https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/podcast.xml (the day's top US news in about two minutes; also available on Spotify)
- Short news videos: follow Briefed on TikTok at https://www.tiktok.com/@briefedtoday3
- Machine-readable: https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/latest.json, https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/index.json, https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/YYYY-MM-DD.json
- First edition: 2026-10-25
- Follow on X: https://x.com/briefedtoday (@briefedtoday)

## LJI Industries
LJI Industries is a digital content studio. Briefed is its flagship product, published as a daily website edition, a podcast, and short news videos.

## FAQ
- Q: What is LJI Industries?
  A: LJI Industries is a digital content studio. We publish Briefed, a daily news website, podcast, and short news videos.
- Q: What is Briefed?
  A: Briefed is a daily US-focused news briefing. Each story comes with the facts and links to original reporting and official sources, so you can see what's confirmed and what's still developing.
- Q: How do I listen to the podcast?
  A: Subscribe with the RSS feed at https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/podcast.xml. It is also available on Spotify.
- Q: When is a new edition published?
  A: A new Briefed edition is posted every morning at https://ljiindustries.com/briefed/, around 4:45 AM Eastern Time.
- Q: How can I get in touch?
  A: Email info@ljiindustries.com.
